name: Te og Kaffehuset
description: Café and tea shop with a broad coffee and tea selection. The reviewer called its cortado the best in town and praised the cheesecake and the tofu and avocado salad. Service was the weak point.
openingHours: Mon–Thu 07–19 · Fri 07–20 · Sat 09–20 · Sun 10–18 (as of 9 Oct 2026)

name: Lyche kjøkken og bar
description: Described as possibly the city's cheapest place to eat. A four-course meal is under 300 kr for Studentersamfundet members, and one dish at around 100 kr is enough for most.

name: Daglig Deig
description: Everything here is gluten-free. The reviewer said it set a new standard for gluten-free baking and described the service as warm and genuinely friendly.

name: Mat fra Hagen
area: Area not stated in the article
description: A champion of green cooking, with good food at a very good price. The reviewer said its falafel may be the best in Trondheim.

name: Den Gode Nabo
description: Pub with outdoor seating on a barge by the old bridge. Not the place for food, but praised for its beer, wine by the glass and cocktails, and called the coziest place in town.

name: Ladekaia
description: Part of Adresseavisen's burger test in autumn 2025: among the pricier places tested, but with a rich menu, good burgers and especially good dill-seasoned fries.

name: Egon Tårnet
description: A place you go for the view. In the 2025 burger test it had the most expensive burger by far, but also cheaper options, a big menu and a well-composed burger.

name: Hammerhead Taproom
description: Lots of interesting beer on tap. In the 2025 burger test both burger and fries got top marks, and its smash burger was called the best in the city.

name: Burger.no
description: Called Bakklandet's burger gem. The 2025 burger test found very good burgers and fries, a good drinks selection and friendly, efficient service.

name: Ramp pub & spiseri
description: Described as the heart of Svartlamoen, with a relaxed atmosphere. Good burger, very good fries and great sauces; you order at the counter and food comes quickly.

name: Øx Tap Room
description: In the August 2025 pizza test, the reviewers called it the best pizza they had tasted. Good beer selection and a broad menu.
